_purpose: Params of tools/tripo-pipeline/blender/static_prop_candidate.py for the lantern candidate (from candidate-params.template.json, <task8> = 26bb832e). All numbers are proposals or measurement settings, not accepted values.
_target_height_m: 0.95 = inside both the 04 card range 90-110 uu (proposed) and the S05 gate 90-100 uu (AD-CNF-56, open)
_ao_distance_m: 0.04: barrel used 0.03 at 26 uu height; lantern detail (rivets, frame bars, roof edge) has a similar absolute size, so AO distance is not scaled with height
_geometry_repair: tripo_cracks, decided after the first run failed require_closed_manifold (its numbers are in docs/art-pipeline/prop-lantern-report.json, blenderStage.firstRun): the Tripo mesh has 13 open + 1 non-manifold welded edges = three collinear T-junction cracks (z 0.603 at the hinge-side door bottom, z 0.762 on both side panes), one collinear zero-area triangle at a post corner (z 0.563; clean_mesh deletes it and leaves a T-junction crack) and a 5-face flipped sliver fin (~9.8 cm2 pre-scale) along the hinge-side door frame, attached by the non-manifold edge. Nothing is filled: fins are deleted, cracks welded, and the run fails if anything stays open
_front_check: axis_extent: the lantern front is the door hardware (two hinges + latch), not one protrusion at mid height (there the square post corners win). In the band 0.62-0.76 of the height only the door hardware has vertices; measured before the run on the Tripo GLB: -Y 0.1216 m vs runner-up +X 0.0928 m (pre-scale), so a 0.01 m margin after scaling leaves room
_glow_slot: Glass decision: second slot M_Decor_LanternGlow on the glass faces (as M_Decor_FacadeGlow of the facades), same BC/N/ORM; faces chosen by the blue-grey glass colour of the Tripo BC (B - R >= 15 on 8-bit encoded values, measured: glass 19-21, iron 5-9, bronze < 0) on >= 50 % of 28 barycentric samples. Emission here is a Blender preview (#FFC27A, 03 C-6 range, strength 3); the UE emissive colour/intensity is an MI parameter (deferred)
